problem_description: Map-reduce aggregation of 1,000,000 telemetry metrics into partitioned statistical summaries with mathematical determinism.

rejected_topologies.rejection_reason: Voting / consensus introduces nondeterministic stochastic aggregation overhead, 3x token multiplier, and is fundamentally unsuitable for exact arithmetic reduction.
Dynamic decomposition adds single-orchestrator scheduling latency bottlenecks and non-constant memory overhead when batch boundaries are statically known.

rationale: Split-and-merge provides deterministic parallel execution with bounded memory footprint and commutative superstep state reduction.

tradeoffs.latency: O(log N) aggregation depth with parallel execution across shards.
tradeoffs.cost: Minimal token and compute overhead with zero redundant worker generation.
tradeoffs.deterministic_guarantee: Bit-exact commutative reduction invariant to shard completion order.
